verdict.A: 2 new people with photos (Caddy on Amazon, Jess R. on Ulta) and 1 new text mention (Aimes, about a friend). All incentivized (Vine or free sample). Type 1 now has about 9 people, none non-incentivized. The picture is consistent (defined curls on straight hair; hold varies with fineness). Enough to describe the result, but independence is still low.
verdict.B: Nothing new. No photo of a result on stated wavy hair exists in any source searched. Keep low evidence.
verdict.C: Nothing new. Only the 2 existing free-sample reviews (one photo: waved ends on straightened curly hair). Keep low evidence.
verdict.D: 1 new non-incentivized Verified Purchase review of the exact variant (1 1/2 Inch, Blue) on stated naturally straight hair, with a video of the sleek result: the first real photo of THIS model on type 1. One person only.
